flaws.description: Changed the x-axis label from 'Change in Efficiency Score' to an unrelated quantity, 'Annual Cargo Throughput (Thousand TEUs)'.

Swapped the hex color literals between the Efficiency_Gain and Efficiency_Loss bars, so gains now render in orange (#F28E2B) and losses in blue (#4E79A7), contradicting the summary's color attribution.
Changed the Kenya Main Port Efficiency_Gain value from 20 to 32 (multiplied by 1.6), corrupting a single bar in the tornado chart while leaving the underlying data table unchanged.
